newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on Wednesday were $0.50-$1.00 per cwt higher, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand moderate to good. Seller interest moderate. Offerings light.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs 72.00-73.00 few higher dressing to 74.00 few pt lds to 70.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1300 lbs 72.00-73.00 few pt lds down to 70.00.
Most cattle delivered to packing plants with weighing conditions equivalent to 3 percent shrink at feedlots with some being bought on a picked up (FOB) basis.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Tuesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00, instances $2.00 higher.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 116.00-118.00 latter price western area Holstein (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 106.00-108.00 Holstein (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 109.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 102.000.
